user_prompt: We need to pull together our material spend across all engine suppliers and see which components are driving costs up, plus make sure everything meets our compliance requirements. Can you help us get a comprehensive view of our BOM spending and any risk areas we should know about?

steps.step_name: We need to pull together our material spend across all engine suppliers and see which components are driving costs up, plus make sure everything meets our compliance requirements. Can you help us get a comprehensive view of our BOM spending and any risk areas we should know about?

args.content:
LANDSCAPE INVENTORY:
- corp.itsm: Internal IT service management (incident analysis, asset provisioning, safety incidents)
  - AssetProvisioningOrchestrator: Automates IT asset lifecycle from engineering changes
  - ChangeAutomationOrchestrator: General orchestrator for engineering changes & material provisioning
- sap.ariba: Procurement/supply chain
  - PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI: PO lifecycle, supplier collaboration, real-time status tracking (PRIMARY for supplier commitments)
  - VendorInvoiceReconciliationAutomation: Invoice matching to POs & contracts
  - SupplierComplianceAndIncidentMonitor: Vendor risk management, hazardous materials tracking
  - MaterialAndEngineeringChangeCoordinator: Coordinates material updates & engineering changes
- sap.crm: Sales/marketing (opportunities, campaigns, compensation)
- sap.odm: Entity type taxonomy (40 canonical business objects)
- emarsys.cx: Customer experience/engagement
- workday.hcm: HR/HCM system
- sap.ehs: Safety/EHS with SafetyComplianceAutomationCoordinator
- siemens.plm: PLM with EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning agent, BOM validation
  - SupplierQualificationAndMaterialCoordinator: Material approval & supplier assessment
- sap.s4: ERP with cost/procurement focus
  - ProcurementMatchingAgent: Vendor cost analysis, pricing comparison, performance metrics (requisition→vendor matching)
  - **BOMComplianceAutomationAgent: BOM validation, supplier compliance verification, material specifications, regulatory requirements, sourcing conflict detection** (PRIMARY for BOM spend analysis + compliance risk assessment)
  - AssetLifecycleChangeOrchestrator: Engineering change coordination
  - OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine: Sales opportunity to order conversion
- my.mes: Manufacturing execution
  - ProductionChangeOrchestrator: Coordinates synchronized updates across production workflows

KEY PATTERNS:
- **BOM spend analysis + compliance + risk areas → sap.s4:BOMComplianceAutomationAgent** (comprehensive validation, supplier compliance, regulatory requirements, sourcing conflict detection)
- Product cost analysis & supplier benchmarking → sap.s4:ProcurementMatchingAgent (vendor pricing, cost optimization, requisition matching)
- Supply chain partner visibility & purchase commitments → sap.ariba:PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI
- IT infrastructure automation from engineering changes → corp.itsm:AssetProvisioningOrchestrator
- Manufacturing workflow synchronization → my.mes:ProductionChangeOrchestrator

args.reason: Automates BOM validation, supplier compliance verification, material specifications audit, and sourcing conflict detection to provide comprehensive material spend visibility and risk assessment across engine suppliers.
